name: Intrigue Feats
body:
Intrigue Feats (Ex)
Source Spymaster's Handbook pg. 27
The vigilante gains one of the following feats as a bonus feat: Blustering BluffUI, But a ScratchUI, Call TruceUI, ConfabulistUI, Criminal ReputationUI, Cutting HumiliationUI, Esoteric LinguisticsACG, Intoxicating FlatteryUI, Ironclad LogicUI, Nerve-Racking NegotiatorUI, OratorACG, Persuasive BriberyUI, Play to the CrowdUI, Quick FavorUI, Rhetorical FlourishUI, Sense AssumptionsUI, Sense RelationshipsUI, or Street SmartsUI. He must meet the feat’s prerequisites. This talent can be selected multiple times; each time, the vigilante gains a new feat from the above list.
